title: Save the Pro-finder number in the address book
body_md: So that an incoming alarm message can be assigned quickly, the Pro-finder number should be given a name in the address book of the mobile phone like any other entry. The source recommends a name that puts the entry at the beginning of the address book, but gives two different spellings for it – one in the body text and another in the tip that immediately follows.
source_region: Section 2.5, body text and red tip
prev_context: Before this stands activation without the app.
next_context: The note on the country code and section 2.6 follow.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 14: both versions set different spellings of the same suggested name in the body text and in the tip. The contradiction is therefore documented in both and is not resolved; neither spelling is presented as binding.
